tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search 50,000+ Korean tourist attractions, restaurants, lodging, shopping, culture facilities and festivals by keyword, region and category. Returns name, address, coordinates, phone, image, a short overview and a ktourinfo.com page url.

tools.name: find_nearby_places
tools.description: Places within a radius of a latitude/longitude in Korea, nearest first, with distance in meters. Names are Korean.

tools.name: get_crowd_forecast
tools.description: Daily crowd-level forecast (cnctr_rate, higher = busier) for Korean tourist spots over the next ~30 days. Use it to pick quieter days or spots. Match names in Korean (use search_places with locale 'ko' to get the Korean name first).

tools.name: get_related_places
tools.description: "Visitors to X also visited Y" — related spots ranked from Korean travel-movement data (monthly). Names in Korean.

tools.name: list_festivals
tools.description: Korean festivals and events running at any point between two dates, optionally in one region.

tools.name: generate_itinerary
tools.description: Build a day-by-day sightseeing itinerary for a region: popular spots grouped by day in visiting order with an approximate timetable and meal stops.
